Plugin.Name: file.lock
Plugin.Overview: Lock and unlock individual files on your array or pools directly from the webGUI (Tools -> File Lock), without dropping to a terminal. Browse your shares, search by name, and toggle the immutable flag (chattr +i / -i) on files to protect them from accidental deletion or modification. Selecting a folder applies the flag recursively to every file inside it. Works on XFS, BTRFS, and ZFS.
